specification.objective: Supersede the original workspace-navigation contract with final access rules and guarantee session-revocation UI consistency during password-reset history navigation.

requirements.statement: Kanban is available to managerial users with or without an employee profile, and to ordinary employees only when an employee profile is linked.
Password-reset confirmation clears the cached navigation user whenever it revokes the active session, without replacing the reset/history route.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Workspace widget coverage asserts Kanban is hidden for an unlinked employee and visible for a manager without a profile in both desktop and mobile navigation.

The async reset/history regression delays the next session read, asserts the route-session skeleton contains no former-user destinations after revocation, and confirms protected content never renders.

invariants.statement: The backend remains the authorization authority and protected content remains inaccessible after session revocation.

forbidden_states.statement: An employee without a linked profile sees Kanban, or a revoked user's destinations appear during the route-session skeleton.

inputs.statement: Verified user role/profile and password-reset confirmation during protected route history navigation.

outputs.statement: Role-appropriate workspace navigation and no cached destination after revocation.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget assertions fail if a disallowed destination appears or remains visible after reset revocation.

baseline_output_contains: former-user destination remains visible after reset revocation
